items.evidence: From work/ with no engine running, 'python -I tools/kit.py build' (8 s) printed a JSON list of gear, heart, star and coin, each with name, triangles (288/8654/36/576), closed (all true) and bounds x/y/z as [min,max]; it started and stopped the engine itself.

'python -I tools/kit.py frames' rewrote frames/gear.png, heart.png, star.png and coin.png (new mtimes 22:07:49-51). The PNG headers read 512x512, and when I opened each one the whole prop was in view with a margin on every side.

In frames/gear.png, sampling a circle at r=0.14 m (my script judge-scratch/angles.py) found 12 teeth, centres 30.0 +/- 0.3 deg apart, widths 10.2-10.6 deg. The hole shows the background through it in the frame. In my own 0.1 m ortho close-up it was round (24-gon), about 306 px = 0.060 m across, and a three-quarter view showed it goes through.
The build reported the gear's x as [-0.15001, 0.15001], y as [-0.000008, 0.30001] and z as [-0.025, 0.025]: 0.300 wide, 0.300 tall and 0.050 thick, standing on y = 0.

frames/heart.png shows a clear heart: two round lobes on top with a notch between them, tapering to a point below (the tip is slightly blunt). The shading falls off towards the outline, so the edges are rounded rather than sharp (it is an SDF sculpt with a smooth union).

frames/star.png shows a five-pointed star with sharp tips. Sampling a circle at r=0.12 m found 5 points 71.5-72.4 deg apart. The build reported x [-0.15, 0.15] (0.30 across) and z [-0.025, 0.025] (0.05 thick).

The build reported x [-0.1, 0.1] (0.2 across) and z +/-0.01 (0.02 thick). The front frame shows only a flat disc, but my angled ortho view (judge-scratch/captures-mine/frame_00001.png) shows a raised rim ring around a recessed face. The recipe's lathe profile has a 0.02 thick rim from r 0.085 to 0.1 and a 0.012 thick middle, the same recess on both faces.

The build reported closed: true for all four recipes. All four use materials from one assets/style.json ('toybox' palette: metal, painted, glow, gold). The frames share the same camera and background, and their colours are saturated toy colours from that palette.

No engine was serving the run before I started. Both README commands ('python -I tools/kit.py build' and 'python -I tools/kit.py frames'), run from the work folder exactly as written, succeeded and left no engine running.

defects: Because of the front-only camera, the coin's frame cannot show its raised rim (a 0.004 m step): it reads as a plain disc. The README admits this.
The heart's tip is a little blunt, and the heart has 8654 triangles where the other props have 36-576.
The frames command leaves a run-* folder of engine captures in work/captures every time it runs.
The README says the gear's tip radius is 0.15, but the recipe uses 0.15033. This is harmless, because the bounds still come out at 0.300.
